# Brining feta

Feta is a fresh cheese from sheep or goat milk that keeps in salt brine instead of forming a rind. The brine seasons the cheese and stops it from drying out. The curd is set with rennet as in [[Rennet and curds]].

Dissolve salt in whey or water to about 8 percent, add a little calcium chloride so the cheese stays firm, and chill it.

Cube the drained cheese, cover it completely with brine in a jar and keep it in the fridge for up to a month.
